title: Get Cash Flow Summary Request
description: Total inflow, outflow and net flow for a period, with transaction counts, daily averages and trend. Internal transfers, swaps, self-transfers, gas and failed transactions are handled explicitly and reported in data_quality. Free (fair-use rate limits apply).

chain.description: Blockchain. Celo today; more EVM chains planned.

period.description: Period such as 7d, 30d, 90d or 1y. Ignored if start_date and end_date are given.
